title: Drag a file onto a WhatsApp chat, and better group names and AI drafts
text: You can now drag a file from your computer onto any WhatsApp chat to attach it, the same as the paperclip. In groups, the Members list now shows the names you saved in your phone, and the AI "Suggest a reply" now reads the group's own messages instead of drafting blind.
points: Drag and drop a file onto the chat
Group members show your saved names
AI reply suggestion works in groups
